recognize_zh: 低倍皮膚切片的 lambda 原位雜交（ISH）中，真皮內圍繞附屬器及血管的浸潤區有大量深紫色訊號陽性細胞，陽性細胞數量多、分布廣，與同案 kappa ISH 對照可判斷為 lambda 限制性漿細胞。
features: Scanning magnification of a skin biopsy with epidermis at top and dermis/subcutis below
Numerous dark purple lambda mRNA-positive cells within dermal infiltrate
Positive cells clustered in perivascular, periadnexal and deep dermal nodular aggregates
Pale eosinophilic counterstained collagen with fewer positive cells in the superficial dermis
Individual cell morphology cannot be assessed at this magnification
describe_en: In situ hybridization for lambda light chain mRNA on a skin biopsy, viewed at scanning magnification, shows numerous strongly positive cells distributed in perivascular, periadnexal and deep dermal nodular aggregates. The superficial dermis contains scattered positive cells, and the epidermis is negative. Individual cell morphology cannot be evaluated at this power. When compared with a paired kappa ISH showing few positive cells, the findings indicate lambda-restricted plasmacytic cells, supporting a clonal B-cell process consistent with extranodal marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasma cell-rich dermatitis or syphilis
ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates show a polytypic kappa-to-lambda ratio of roughly 2:1, not a marked lambda predominance.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous involvement by plasma cell myeloma
ddx.vs: Myeloma forms sheets of atypical plasma cells without a background small B-cell and T-cell rich infiltrate and has a marrow correlate.
Follicle center lymphoma consists of centrocytes and centroblasts that are BCL6/CD10 positive and lacks prominent light-chain-restricted plasma cells.
